acceptanceCriteria: A new docs page lists every command safe as a triggered step with its mutation class under invariant 4 (including the two bounded ledgers), exit codes, output profile name, expected runtime and timeout, and required inputs (base SHA, CEM path).

One worked example runs the contract from a fresh clone at a fixed commit (GitHub Actions or a plain shell script) and its receipt is recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md; a fresh-clone limitation from V1-0182 is stated verbatim rather than hidden.
The page states explicitly that Corvint runs no always-on component and that a triggered run grants no authority (decisions 0081 and 0373).
docs/specs/stable-operations-v0.md and docs/AGENT-ROUTES.md link the page; documentation gates pass.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air Teams runs automations on merge-to-main, branch change, PR creation, issue creation and push, and tracks each run. Corvint can already be a stateless step in such triggers (`make dogfood-check`, `corvint cem report`, witness reports, `corvint affected`), but nothing documents which commands are safe as triggered read-only steps, their exit codes, output profiles, timeouts, and what they never do. V1-0182 (dogfood-check fails in a fresh clone) must be fixed or named as a limitation before the contract claims fresh-clone use. No daemon or hosted component is in scope.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-23 by PR #124 (merge 34e798b). Criterion 1: docs/AUTOMATION.md lists each triggered-step-safe command with its invariant-4 mutation class (R0 for affected --base; R0+SOL for cem verify, cem status, witness and impact --base, naming the bounded self-observation ledger), source-cited exit codes, output profile, required inputs and measured runtime with timeout; cem report and make dogfood-check are excluded with reasons. Criterion 2: a worked example ran from a fresh git clone --no-local at 01b6804 against base a6a6b8b, verified the sealed V1-0204 CEM (canonical, 39/39 supported), left the clone unchanged, and reproduced the V1-0182 fresh-clone limitation (dogfood-check fails dogfood-report-missing), stated verbatim; its receipt is in docs/BUILD-LOG.md. Criterion 3: the page states Corvint runs no always-on component and a triggered run grants no authority (decisions 0081 and 0373). Criterion 4: docs/specs/stable-operations-v0.md and docs/AGENT-ROUTES.md link the page; doc checks passed; dogfood-check PASS 4/4, sealed at .corvint/changes/3500aba9b64e7efbab26e9056d06c50ec6e503ca.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 34e798b of the sealed CEM, AUTOMATION.md, AGENT-ROUTES.md and stable-operations-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy; docs-only).

title: ops: document the triggered-automation contract for running Corvint as a read-only step in CI, git hooks and team automations
